description: Parity cases for the Creative gallery's mosaic engine (mosaicLayout.js). `jetpack` is Jetpack Tiled Gallery's own Jest fixture and snapshot, copied from Automattic/jetpack at commit 618b99b578b182fe4fff4d5da712f422c29df64e: extensions/blocks/tiled-gallery/layout/mosaic/test/fixtures/ratios.js and test/__snapshots__/ratios.js.snap (ratiosToMosaicRows, not wide). buildMosaicRows() must return the same row shapes. `legacyRow` is the numeric example from research.md §2.1 worked through Jetpack's legacy PHP math (width 500, margin 4, shape [1, 2]); sizeMosaicRow() runs it as a Modula row of width 496 with gutter 4, which gives the same image sizes. The second column's raw image heights are 118.55 and 111.84 (sum 230.40) and must total 238 - 2 * 4 = 230, so the one missing pixel goes to the larger fraction: [118, 112].
